title: The causal-completion planning sweep rewrites an unchanged pending reason, bumping attempts before the retry runs
outcome: An ordinary planning tick no longer rewrites a pending reason that did not change, while retry-order rotation stays fair.
acceptance: When CausalTestCompletionPlan::replaces returns None, the planning sweep keeps the stored pending reason and its lastAttemptAt; it does not rewrite them.
Retry-order rotation across pending rows stays fair, shown by an observable test of the order rows are pulled in over repeated planning ticks.
A test observes through diagnostics that a planning tick which changes no reason leaves the reason and its attempt metadata as they were.
